propositions: transport.py has repeatedly hit the 800 LOC cap, forcing reactive splits that do not establish a lasting organizational principle, causing the cycle to repeat.

The module's natural boundaries already exist in _backend.py as four capability Protocols (TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsAbsenceProbe) that the transport class satisfies, but are not being used as the organizing principle.
Reorganizing the transport module by capability seams (one mixin per protocol) gives every future operation a determined home determined by capability question rather than space availability.

The refactored architecture preserves the single JiraDataCenterTransport class, Protocols, isinstance checks, and all facades, making this a mechanical relocation with no behavior change or test oracle edits.
The split produces five mixins all in the 100–500 LOC band (not fragments under 100 or over 500), reducing transport.py from 799 to 230 lines and freeing capacity for future parent-related work.
